description.text: Enjoy a unique trip to Machu Picchu with a personalized small-group service. You will travel by train through the Sacred Valley, explore the incredible sanctuary of Machu Picchu on a guided visit and return comfortably to Cusco. An unforgettable experience at the most important archaeological site in South America.

items: 4:00 AM: Pick-up from your hotel in Cusco
6:10 AM: Tourist train from Ollantaytambo to Aguas Calientes
8:00 AM: Bus to Machu Picchu (30 min)
8:30 AM: Entrance and guided visit (2 hours)
10:30 AM: Free time to explore on your own
1:00 PM: Lunch (not included) and free time
Bus up and down to Machupicchu (Consettur)
Private transfer Ollantaytambo – Hotel in Cusco.
Entrance to Machupicchu Mountain or Waynapicchu
Meals not mentioned in the program
Snacks and a bottle of water
Cash for souvenirs and other expenses
